Her basic attacks and ''{{ai|Final Spark|Lux}}'' consume the mark to deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}. |description = {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Lux's''' {{tip|abilities}} apply a mark to enemies hit for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits.

'''Lux's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and ''{{ai|Final Spark|Lux}}'' consume the mark to deal {{as|{{pplevel|30 to 200}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 35% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}. |targeting = Passive |affects = Enemies |damagetype = Magic |spellshield = special |spelleffects = Proc |parry = unknown |projectile = |grounded = |knockdown = |notes = * Starting an {{tip|attack windup}} against a target with a mark that is about to expire refreshes its duration to {{fd|0.25}} seconds. Casting ''{{ai|Final Spark|Lux}}'' refreshes the marks of all marked enemies to {{fd|1.25}} seconds if they are within {{tt|5000|Estimated}} units of the ability's casting position and have a mark with a remaining duration of less than 1 second. * {{tip|Spell shield}} prevents {{ai|Final Spark|Lux}} from consuming the mark. ** The on-hit damage from ''Illumination'' via basic attack cannot be blocked by ''spell shield''. * ''Illumination'' will be consumed but not deal any damage if the basic attack is {{tip|blocked}}. * ''Illumination'' will not be consumed if the basic attack misses due to {{tip|blind}}. * ''Illumination'' will not be consumed if the basic attack misses due to {{tip|dodge}}. |yvideo = 1Wq1wZIksPI }}

W.name: Prismatic Barrier
W.title: Template:Data Lux/Prismatic Barrier
W.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Prismatic Barrier|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Lux
|skill        = W
|icon         = Prismatic Barrier.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Lux}} throws her wand in the target direction that homes back to her after reaching maximum range.
|blurb2       = Allied champions hit by the wand gain a {{tip|shield}} for a short time, which can stack up to twice. '''Lux''' receives the shield upon throwing the wand and upon its return.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lux''' throws her wand in the target direction that homes back to her after reaching maximum range. Allied champions hit by the wand gain a {{tip|shield}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds, which can stack up to 2 times, stacking with the previous shield and refreshing its duration.
|leveling     = {{st|Shield Strength|{{ap|40 to 100}} {{as|(+ 40% AP)}}|Maximum Shield|{{ap|40*2 to 100*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40*2}}% AP)}}}}
|description2 =  '''Lux''' gains the shield upon throwing and upon retrieving the wand.
|range        = {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 1175
|width        = {{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|220|Both outgoing and returning, homing missile}}
|effect radius= {{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|110|Circle check upon commencing of direction reversal}}
|speed        = {{tt|2400|Original speed; decelerates/accelerates depending on travel time, see notes}}
|cooldown     = {{ap|12 to 10}}
|cast time    = {{tt|{{fd|0.25}}|Effect starts at beginning of cast time}}
|cost         = {{ap|60 to 80}}
|costtype     = Mana
|targeting    = Direction
|affects      = Allies
|damagetype   = 
|spellshield  = 
|spelleffects = 
|projectile   = special
|grounded     = 
|knockdown    = 
|notes        = 
* Each pass of the wand grants a shield to each target once.
* ''Prismatic Barrier'' may only stack up to 2 times. Subsequent instances of passing through the wand have no effect on the shield's strength nor duration.
* The shield will also be granted to allies near the wand's return location.
* Both passes of ''Prismatic Barrier'' cannot hit units whose {{tip|center range|center}} is beyond the missile range or behind its origin, even if their {{tip|edge range|hitbox radius}} overlaps.
** At the return location, this behaviour is overridden by an additional center check with the same diameter as the missile width.
* If '''Lux''' {{tip|death|dies}} before her wand returns it will fizzle upon reaching maximum range.
* There is an additional circle check at the end of the missile's length that allows it to hit the edge of an ally's radius. This is intended.
* '''Lux's''' wand decelerates on the way out and accelerates on the way back.
{{Effect at cast time start}}
* ''Prismatic Barrier'' is destroyed by {{ai|Wind Wall|Yasuo}}, {{ai|Blade Whirl|Samira}}, and {{ai|Rebuttal|Mel}} but not {{ai|Unbreakable|Braum}}.
|yvideo       = siy2UhTGTas
}}

E.name: Lucent Singularity
E.title: Template:Data Lux/Lucent Singularity
E.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Lucent Singularity|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Lux
|skill        = E
|icon         = Lucent Singularity.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Lux}} sends a lucent singularity to the target location that lasts for a few seconds and slows enemies within.
|blurb2       = ''Lucent Singularity'' can be recast within this time, and does so automatically after the duration.
|blurb3       = {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Lux''' detonates the singularity, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lux''' sends a lucent singularity to the target location, remaining there for 5 seconds to grant {{tip|sight}} of the area and {{tip|slow}} nearby enemies. 
|leveling     = {{st|Slow|{{ap|25 to 45}}%}}
|description2 = ''Lucent Singularity'' can be recast at any time while it is in flight or within the duration, and does so automatically after the duration.
|description3 = {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Lux''' detonates the singularity, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within. If ''Lucent Singularity'' was recast while in flight, it will detonate upon arrival.
|leveling3    = {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|65 to 265}} {{as|(+ 80% AP)}}}}
|description4 = The slow lingers for 1 second after leaving the area. Enemies hit by ''Lucent Singularity's'' detonation are also slowed by the same amount for 1 second.
|target range = 1100
|effect radius= {{dv|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|310|Singularity radius}}|{{tip|sight|icononly=true}}{{tt|650|Sight radius}}}}
|speed        = 1200
|cooldown     = {{ap|10 to 8}}
|cdstart      = on-cast
|cost         = {{ap|70 to 110}}
|cast time    = {{fd|0.25}}
|costtype     = Mana
|targeting    = {{dv|[[Location-targeted|Location]]|[[Auto-targeted|Auto]]}}
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Magic
|spellshield  = True
|spelleffects = Area of effect
|projectile   = True
|grounded     = 
|knockdown    = 
|outofrange   = Walk in range of the target location to cast (first cast)
|notes        = 
* The initial cast counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
** The manual recast does not.
* ''Lucent Singularity'' grants {{tip|sight}} while also in flight.
* The ability will not preserve the caster's facing direction when using {{si|Flash}} and similar effects.
|yvideo       = FEKKH9ThD4A
}}
